AI_HARNESS.TITLE: Spec-Driven AI Engineering & Agent Harness Platform
AI_HARNESS.PROBLEM: Unstructured AI prompting leads to architectural drift, broken regressions, and non-deterministic code generation across complex production codebases.
AI_HARNESS.ARCHITECTURE: Implemented a spec-driven engineering workflow with structured context harnesses, executable specifications, architectural design contracts, and tracked deterministic tasks.
AI_HARNESS.IMPACT: Eliminated architectural drift across complex migrations, guaranteed 100% spec adherence, and achieved zero regressions through automated quality gates.

RAPPI_PLATFORM.TITLE: High-Concurrency Internal Operations Ecosystem (Rappi)
RAPPI_PLATFORM.PROBLEM: Rapidly scaling operations across LATAM required resilient internal tools and low-latency backend services capable of handling heavy real-time traffic.
RAPPI_PLATFORM.ARCHITECTURE: Distributed microservices in Golang, Kotlin, and Node.js (Express/AdonisJS) paired with Angular/React/Vue frontends, Redis/Memcached caching, PostgreSQL/MongoDB/DynamoDB, and Docker/Jenkins CI/CD.
RAPPI_PLATFORM.IMPACT: Sub-second order state propagation, 99.99% uptime during peak promotional campaigns, and fault-tolerant operational pipelines.

CLOUD_IAC.TITLE: Cloud Infrastructure & Unified Reusable CI/CD
CLOUD_IAC.PROBLEM: Fragmented, redundant deployment scripts across multi-cloud environments caused slow release cycles and configuration drift.
CLOUD_IAC.ARCHITECTURE: Engineered modular Infrastructure as Code (Terraform for AWS, Bicep for Azure) and created a centralized DRY pipeline library shared across GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
CLOUD_IAC.IMPACT: Reduced pipeline maintenance overhead by 40%+, slashed deployment cycle times by 65%, and achieved zero-downtime automated releases with policy-as-code guardrails.

REACTIVE_WEB.TITLE: Multi-Client Reactive Web Applications & Internationalization
REACTIVE_WEB.PROBLEM: Global web applications require sub-second initial loads, responsive layouts across devices, and seamless runtime localization.
REACTIVE_WEB.ARCHITECTURE: Modular frontend architecture using Angular, RxJS, and native IntersectionObserver motion directives with dynamic JSON translation loaders across English, Spanish, and Japanese.
REACTIVE_WEB.IMPACT: Sub-second initial render, zero-reload locale switching, and WCAG AA accessible (a11y) responsive layouts from mobile to ultra-wide desktops.

ENTERPRISE_ERP.TITLE: Enterprise Project Management & Accounting ERP
ENTERPRISE_ERP.PROBLEM: Complex financial and project accounting workflows demanded strict transactional integrity and responsive web reporting.
ENTERPRISE_ERP.ARCHITECTURE: Multi-tier .NET / C# web architecture backed by SQL Server and optimized Transact-SQL stored procedures, delivered iteratively under SCRUM.
ENTERPRISE_ERP.IMPACT: Automated mission-critical accounting for 500+ concurrent enterprise users with sub-second report generation and zero transactional data loss.
